verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships a full Swagger REST spec covering OpenAI-compatible and LocalAI-specific endpoints, with a runtime discovery endpoint and interactive Swagger UI. A /models/apply endpoint shows that gallery model installation, which the UI's Discover page also does, is reachable via the API. However, no evidence explicitly claims UI-to-API parity or shows that UI functions such as agent configuration, user/role administration and message editing are exposed through the API. Missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, documented API coverage of agent management and admin/user management, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
